remaining_limits: Local startup and unsupported synthetic queue dispatch are measured, not additional SEO repairs or certification of every correctable anomaly.
healthz is HTTP liveness only; strict configuration validation does not prove database connectivity, schema readiness or customer capacity.
PLAN_CONFIG_JSON restoration only reads configuration available to that process. A web-disk override is not automatically shared with a diskless worker on another host.
